before_times: What's wrong: dead outlets, a breaker that trips, flickering lights, no power, a new install, or something else
Did a breaker trip? Does the reset button on an outlet reset?
What was plugged in or running when it went off
After hours: is power out right now
For an EV charger or a new circuit: which charger or appliance, and where the panel is
At the counter: which lamp or fixture, how many sockets, and how old
after_time: Who will be there: the customer, or someone else (their name and mobile go on the secure page)
Access, parking and pets, and where the panel is
Own or rent, and who pays: the customer, or the landlord or manager
A home warranty or an insurance claim: the customer pays, and gets the receipt and photos for the claim
The year the home was built: only for jobs that may open a wall
HOA or building rules: only for outside work or a shared panel
secure_page_only: The landlord's or manager's name and mobile
intake_questions.who_may_book: An adult. A renter books, and the landlord or manager OKs it where they pay. A person the owner of the home names may book for them.

stop.words: Smoke, sparks, a burning smell, or a hot panel, outlet or switch
stop.says: Get everyone out, and don't touch the panel. Call 911 from outside.
stop.booking: No booking until the fire department says the home is safe. The customer can come back then.

stop.words: A downed or sparking power line
stop.says: Stay at least 30 feet away, and keep others away. Call the power company's emergency line, or 911 if it's sparking or anyone is hurt.
stop.booking: No booking now. Damage on the house's side, like the meter box or the pipe the wires come in through, is booked once the power company makes it safe.

stop.words: Someone got a shock or is hurt
stop.says: Don't touch them if they may still be touching power. Call 911.
stop.booking: No booking until it's safe; the customer can come back.

stop.says: Leave the house now. Then call 911 and the gas company.

go_on.words: Water near outlets, a light or the panel
go_on.says: Stay away from the water and anything plugged in. Don't touch a switch or the panel while standing in water. Switch off that breaker only from a dry spot.

go_on.words: A breaker that won't reset, or power out in part of the home
go_on.says: Don't keep resetting it. Unplug what's on that circuit. If you smell burning, get out and call 911.

go_on.words: A lamp or cord that sparked (at the counter)
go_on.says: Unplug it and don't use it. Bring it in, or book a home visit if it's wired into the house.

safety_and_stop_words.always: Always on: danger to life, fire, gas, or a medical emergency gets 'call 911' first.

prep: Clear a path to the panel, and around the outlets or lights to fix
Don't keep resetting a breaker that trips
At the counter: bring the lamp with its shade, harp and bulb; a chandelier comes with its chain and canopy

skills: Solar (its own license where the state asks)
staff.supervision: An apprentice works only with a journeyman or master on the job, where the state's rules require it. An apprentice is never sent alone by default.
staff.who_oks: The owner OKs fees, quotes over the limit, panel jobs and same-day jobs. After hours, a job sent now goes to the electrician on call, then the backup set at sign-up. An office manager may OK prices if the owner sets it.
staff.stand_in: Another electrician with the same skill and level, at the same window and price.

children_and_age.who_may_book: An adult. A renter books, and the landlord or manager OKs it where they pay. A person the owner of the home names may book for them.

visit.done: The electrician texts DONE with the bill's lines, and photos after. Nobody home needed: DONE with a photo.
visit.changes_at_visit: Quoted by text up to the owner's limit (the example: $500). Above it, the owner OKs it first. A bigger job, like a panel, gets its own quote.
visit.before_work: Photos of the panel and the work area before work; the year the home was built before opening a wall.

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: Electrical work in a home needs a license where the state, city or county licenses electricians. Some states license by job size or kind of work, like residential-only or limited licenses.
license.who: Both: the company (an electrical contractor license, where the state asks) and each electrician (apprentice, journeyman or master, where the state licenses people).
ask: The company's license number and class
Each electrician's own number and level, in their invite reply
The local license for the job's city or county, where only cities or counties license home electrical work
Any specialty license and its limits, like low voltage, solar or signs: from the state form
license.insurance: Liability insurance, and a bond where the state's form asks for one: from the state form.
license.background: Only where the state's form asks.

never_in_a_text: Gate or lock codes, card details, and photos from inside the home or of the panel: these stay on the secure page.
